| description = Rare spawn on the Live Side, near [[a minotaur elder]], in the very back of the room up the steps (next to the firepot). Raster or his PH will despawn at 8am game time and respawn at 10am game time. Given the 28 minute respawn time in Lower Guk, there are 3 PH/Raster possibilities per EQ day (72 minutes) which should roughly correspond to the in-game times below if the PHs are killed promptly. Note that these are estimates based on PH time-of-death except for the 10am respawn.

8am - Despawn if anything is up

10am - Respawn - Kill this PH

7pm to 8pm - Respawn - Kill this PH

4am to 5am - Respawn - You can either kill or leave this PH up. A mob will spawn at 10am regardless

Raster can spawn on any pop not just at 10am. A mob does not have to be present for the 10am spawn to occur. 

For Further Tips see the [[Talk:Raster of Guk|talk page]]

NOTE: It is in your best interest to kill the 10 AM spawn as swiftly as possible, and each spawn thereafter immediately as well: Except for the first ("10am"), each will simply spawn 28 minutes after the previous dies. If you have taken too long to kill each spawn and the last ("4am to 5am") doesn't pop until 7am (and it's Raster), then you're risking him despawning (at 8am) while you are still fighting him. In essence, you have a total combat window of 10 minutes to kill three spawns. Don't waste 9 minutes on the first two spawns and then watch Raster appear for 30 seconds before he despawns on you. Use the time to your advantage! Raster sucks.
